Row.Text: A famed war-engineer turns their mind now towards works of art: public fountains, water-screws, wheels operated by steam. The generals mutter - what is the use of all this?
Innovation has always benefited Assyria, even with no obvious application. Bolster science.
Science for science’s sake is useless. Make better siege engines.

A lamassu of steel gazes down on the engineering quadrangle at Assyria’s premier university. It is customary for all graduates to leave a copy of their senior thesis at the giant clawed feet, and proclaim how they will extend the reach of Ashur across the world. But now, surprisingly, students begin to reject this as “antiquated” and even “militaristic nonsense.”
It is militaristic. It is not nonsense.
